title: Complete Executed Test Population Contract
description: Opt-in outputContract.resultPopulation under command-result. Standing requires host-verified execution origin, package-owned native collection and complete final results from the same execution, agreeing with expected IDs and selected source census. Results-only and authored rosters prove no selection. Node TAP remains diagnostic UNKNOWN without complete native provenance (ADR-SCR-0017).

projectName.description: Exact native runner project name, including the empty default name. Distinct from projectId, the stable task result namespace. Initially exactly one native project may be collected; unrelated or multiple projects refuse rather than merge.

selectionEvidence.description: Selects the known installed package-owned reporter. Host verifies actual native executable, reporter path/bytes/closure and same-process collection/final facts using an internally injected nonce not controlled by descriptor environment. It is not a caller-declared attestation.

prefix.description: Exact reviewed project transport prefix, removed only at physical line starts. Other project streams cannot be merged into this population. Cache replay cannot become actual execution.

executableFiles.description: Canonical path-sorted complete selected executable file roster. Must equal the trusted native preexecution collection and final population. Task inputPaths and this authored list are comparisons, not independent selection proof; dynamic config execution conservatively binds all tracked candidate files except the canonical planner harness-mutated prefixes .devai/state/, record/ and scratch/.

requiredTestIds.description: Exact complete expected native leaf-test ID set, not a count or sample. ID is test:v1: plus encodeURIComponent(canonical JSON [projectId,portable sourceFile,ancestorTitles,testTitle]); no ordinal or line fallback. Semantic canonical decoding and exact equality to native final IDs are mandatory.

serviceProfile.description: Optional finite owned service request (ADR-SCR-0020). Missing/candidate backend records or an unimplemented backend/profile refuse before provisioning. Declaration alone grants no effect, endpoint, execution origin or standing.
